keys.note: pinned without a kid in one-key.json

note: The fixture starter, https://issuer.example, and its keys, derived from the seed, bytes 193 to 224, in base64url. RSA: p is the first prime at or above the 1024-bit number SHA-256(seed || "rs256-p" || 0x00) || ... || SHA-256(seed || "rs256-p" || 0x03) with its two highest bits and its lowest bit set, searched upward in steps of two, with p - 1 not a multiple of 65537; q the same with "rs256-q"; e is 65537. ECDSA on P-256: the private scalar is SHA-256(seed || "es256" || 0x00), big endian. Ed25519: the key's seed is SHA-256(seed || "eddsa" || 0x00). Each public key is the PEM file named, a PKIX SubjectPublicKeyInfo. These keys are public: anyone can derive their private keys from the seed. Forager refuses each in a configuration; never pin them.
